q: Compare last week's performance against this week and identify the likely causes.

checks.what: tool: compares against last week or same weekdays last week

answer:
Net sales fell from ₹645,654 (last week 2026-10-05–10-11) to ₹184,022 (this week to date 2026-10-12–10-14, partial) — a ₹461,632 drop (−71.5%), driven by far fewer orders and lower site sessions; ROAS actually improved slightly so efficiency is not the primary issue. 

Evidence
- Key totals
  - Last week (2026-10-05–10-11): Net sales ₹645,654 · Orders 339 · Ad spend ₹430,736 · Net ROAS 0.84 · Net profit −₹68,271
  - This week so far (2026-10-12–10-14, partial): Net sales ₹184,022 · Orders 98 · Ad spend ₹122,002 · Net ROAS 0.96 · Net profit −₹4,728
- What the diagnosis found (likely contributors, tested):
  - Largest mechanical driver: Gross sales fell sharply (a ~₹76,912 effect in the detailed bridge for the event window) — the product-level revenue lines and return/cancel movements explain most of the sales drop.
  - Traffic and demand fell: Sessions dropped ~39% and Orders fell ~71% (orders 339 → 98), which directly reduced sales.
  - Ad spend fell ~71% (₹430,736 → ₹122,002) and moved together with sessions/orders (same-day association), but the analysis could not establish it as the root cause — it is correlated.
  - Clicks did not show an unusual change and were ruled out as an explanatory cause.
- Confidence and limits
  - No single upstream cause met the statistical bar for being named a cause; the engine reports sessions, add‑to‑cart and ad spend moved together but cannot tell directionality.
  - This-week numbers are partial (data as of 15:13 IST on 2026-10-14); include more days to confirm the trend.
